about: Example review.json: read by eye on contact/timeline (0.5 s tiles); the server is confirmed on contact/serve_closeups (0.1 s). serves: t = racket contact (s), server R = you (near player), O = opponent. rally_ends: t = last moment of live play (last hit, lunge or shuttle landing), shuttle = side where it came down (R / O / null if not visible). One rally end between two serves; the last rally may have none if the video stops during it. 'note' is free text, not read by the scripts.

serves.note: opponent serves; contact time read on the 0.1 s close-up

rally_ends.note: serve fault: lands on your side, the point is yours
